notes.title: Light Path Update for Shadow Movement
notes.content:
When the fox fire is activated, the location of the shadows generated and the length of light between the characters are visually displayed, making it easier to use the shadow movement.

Fixed a bug where light paths were created in multi-refracting mirrors and shadows were inserted at the bottom of the existing mirror object.

Fixed bugs in the attack judgment and detection judgment of monsters.

Fixed a bug in which the monster reacted to items that neutralized the monster or the character was not detected.

notes.title: Update Error Correction
notes.content:
- Increase duration after creating tutorial text
- Add full text skip function (you can skip to F key)
- Some stage grids (geography) bugs and jumps, and fox fire control bugs are modified.
- Modifying the multi-deflection mirror system bug and inserting the relevant partial description text
- Modify monster strike bugs and adjust the partial balance of character vitality.
- Correct system errors (warning statements, setup windows, storage systems)
- Fixing errors related to sound (distance-based sound playback and sound continuous playback bugs)
- Insert specific tutorial-related phrases into the image
